releases.name: 0.1.0 — OpenCode V2 model fallback
releases.body:
First public release of @melivo/opencode-model-fallback.

- Native OpenCode V2 server export, with the legacy entry point retained.
- Explicit fallback-chain configuration; safe empty defaults without personal deployment data.
- Isolated package installation and functional fixtures verified with OpenCode 2.0.25.
- Gated semantic-release automation prepared for npm Trusted Publishing.
